records.title: refactor(analysis): one producer-owned repair-packet eligibility authority
records.release_claim: all repair-packet consumers use one typed fail-closed eligibility authority
records.reason: Duplicated readiness/actionability conjunctions can diverge across agent, review, and editor surfaces; parity tests show the refactor preserves current exclusions while centralizing ownership.
records.non_claim: Centralized eligibility does not promote preview evidence, execute edits, or prove a suggested repair is correct.
